description: Shell script for testing 'exclude_patterns' functionality in Git reference store, including setup, exclusion regions, and assertions.

methods.name: for_each_ref__exclude
methods.description: Runs 'test-tool ref-store main --for-each-ref--exclude' with given arguments and processes output.

methods.name: for_each_ref
methods.description: Runs 'git for-each-ref' with specified format and arguments.

methods.name: assert_jumps
methods.description: Checks if the trace contains expected jump count based on ref format.

methods.name: assert_no_jumps
methods.description: Asserts that no jumps are present in the trace.
